purpose: Retrospective matched following-wheat yield difference: cover yield minus fallow yield, in t/ha
exposure: Source pairs and earlier absolute-yield results have been inspected. This protocol is fixed before direct contrast fitting and contrast scoring; the five historical seasons are development evidence, not an untouched final test.
parameters: Exactly reuse Ridge settings from water_yield_protocol_v1.json and fixed tree settings from water_yield_model_comparison_v1.json; no search or post-result changes
indirect_models: Subtract main-cohort water_weather out-of-fold cover and fallow predictions for each of the three existing algorithms. No all-data predictions or fits on the held-out season.
training: Equal weight per eligible pair; StandardScaler fitted on training pairs only for Ridge. Trees unscaled. No IDs, arm yields, nitrate, revenue, target transforms, clipping or imputation as predictors. No synthetic targets.
validation: Reuse the five frozen paired leave-one-harvest-season-out folds. Cover and shared control must have the same role; no control may span training and evaluation within a fold. Repeated plots across seasons remain possible. This is historical cross-season validation, not future-only or new-site testing.
primary: Direct Ridge delta_water_weather: unweighted mean of five season MAEs in t/ha, versus zero and training-mean difference baselines
secondary: All declared direct and indirect models
MAE averaged equally across unique controls within each season, then equally across seasons
Benefit recall, harm recall, balanced accuracy and raw decision accuracy
Predicted-cover fraction and benefit/harm confusion counts
Observed matched-pair yield opportunity loss relative to choosing the higher observed yield
decision_diagnostic: Predict cover only when predicted delta exceeds 1e-12; otherwise fallow. Numerical zero is not an agronomic or financial threshold. Exclude observed numerical ties from directional accuracy; either choice has zero yield opportunity loss on a tie. Always-fallow policy is therefore represented by the zero baseline.
uncertainty: 68 pairs share 20 controls and recur across five seasons; do not bootstrap pairs as independent observations or report an independent-fold confidence interval. Report per-season spread and class counts. No calibrated uncertainty or causal individual-treatment-effect claim.
limits: Observed cash-crop-sowing water differences and realized weather are future intermediates relative to the earlier cover-planting decision. Yield excludes cover costs and other services; profit is not evaluated. No promotion, API/payload changes or early water-model implementation.
